stretch.method: High end = lower of (a) the conservative affordability ceiling: repayments at rate+2pts over 25 years within 30% of gross income, keeping a $20k cash buffer, FHOR duty and $3k costs included; and (b) the 40th percentile of lag-adjusted 3-bed house medians in middle/outer southern suburbs. Low end = $625k (first price that clearly exceeds the $600k duty-free threshold by more than typical negotiation).

temperature.formula: Weighted mean of signal scores (-2 strongly bearish .. +2 strongly bullish). Scores are analyst judgements mapped from cited data, not statistics.

monthly_path_reconstruction.method: Perth dwelling index levels relative to 31 Oct 2026 = 1.000, rebuilt from Cotality published changes: +3.9% y/y; peak Apr 2026 = 1/0.911; Aug-Oct quarter -5.7% with Sep -2.1% and Oct -1.7% (so Aug ~ -2.0%); May-Jul evenly spread; Nov 2025-Apr 2026 evenly spread. Used ONLY to estimate how far a 12-month median (Nov 2025-Oct 2026) sits above the Oct 2026 level. Approximate.

duty.rule: WA first home owner rate for homes, agreements on/after 7 May 2026: $0 to $600,000; $16.15 per $100 (or part) above $600,000 up to $800,000; general rate above $800,000. Eligibility aligned with First Home Owner Grant Act 2000 criteria (FHOG value cap no longer applies to the duty concession).
duty.fhog: The $10,000 WA First Home Owner Grant applies to NEW homes only (not established). Separate from the duty concession. Verify current caps with RevenueWA before relying on it.
duty.guarantee: Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme (Housing Australia): Perth price cap $850,000, no income cap, unlimited places since 1 Oct 2025, removes LMI for eligible buyers at 5%+ deposit. Confirmed by multiple secondary sources only; verify with Housing Australia / lender.
